# DiegoDella developer resources

> Machine-readable API discovery and integration guidance for diegodella.ar.

## When to use these resources

- Use the developer portal for the public API quickstart, access policy, quotas, safe retries, and versioning.
- Use OpenAPI when generating a client or function definition.
- Use the read-only status operation for harmless availability and discovery checks.
- Use the contact operation only when a real message should be delivered.

## Documentation

- [Developer portal](https://diegodella.ar/developers.html)
- [Markdown API reference](https://diegodella.ar/docs/api.md)
- [Authentication policy](https://diegodella.ar/auth.md)
- [Problem catalog](https://diegodella.ar/docs/problems.md)

## Machine-readable contracts

- [OpenAPI 3.1](https://diegodella.ar/openapi.json)
- [RFC 9727 API catalog](https://diegodella.ar/.well-known/api-catalog)
- [ARD v1 resource catalog](https://diegodella.ar/.well-known/ai-catalog.json)
- [API status](https://diegodella.ar/api/v1/status)
